limitations: Single public English dataset; prior JEV exposure unknown.
34 features omit distinctions in 77 labels; some overlap and correlate.
E3/E4 judgments derive from intent groups rather than human search judgments.
E3 paraphrases are correlated within 25 groups; do not use query-level confidence intervals for population claims.
